The variable catalog

Source: R/variables.R
soil_variables.Rd

The registered variables (GET /variables): canonical soil properties (organic_carbon, clay, ...) and variables published by products, with where they are available and, for each one, the source codes that map to it in each dataset (source_mappings, see soil_variable_mappings()).

Usage

soil_variables(
  soil = soil_session(),
  code = NULL,
  domain = NULL,
  measurement_kind = NULL,
  target_level = NULL,
  dataset = NULL,
  provider = NULL,
  available_only = FALSE,
  include_unmapped = FALSE
)

Arguments

soil

A session; the default session when omitted. Client-side: not sent to the API.

code

Variable codes (variable_code, e.g. "organic_carbon"). API query parameter code.

domain

Domains (domain_code, e.g. "soil"). API query parameter domain.

measurement_kind

Measurement kinds (measurement_kind_code, e.g. "observed"). API query parameter measurement_kind.

target_level

Target levels allowed for the variable ("horizon", "profile", "feature", ...). API query parameter target_level.

dataset

Datasets where the variable has values or a source mapping (e.g. "wosis_points"); the mappings are limited to them too. API query parameter dataset.

provider

Providers (e.g. "isric"), as dataset. API query parameter provider.

available_only

Only variables with at least one value. API query parameter available_only.

include_unmapped

Also list the source codes that map to no variable, in soil_metadata(x)$unmapped_source_codes. API query parameter include_unmapped.

Value

A data frame, one row per variable: variable_code, name, description, domain_code, value_type, measurement_kind_code, allowed_target_levels (list), property_family, property_family_name, documentation_url, the counts of published values value_count and feature_count, datasets, providers, available_target_levels, statuses, product_versions (lists of character), min_depth_cm, max_depth_cm, valid_time_start, valid_time_end, coverage (list: the GeoJSON extent of the published values, NULL when none) and source_mappings (list of data frames, see soil_variable_mappings()). The attribute soil_metadata holds variable_count, unmapped_included, unmapped_source_code_count, unmapped_source_codes (data frame provider_code, dataset_code, source_code, observation_count), the request and retrieved_at.

Details

Every filter is optional (NULL, the default, means no filter; "ALL" is not accepted) and takes several values.

Rights: soil:summary.

See also

soil_variable_mappings()

Other discovery: soil_api_info(), soil_capabilities(), soil_citations(), soil_code_list(), soil_code_lists(), soil_countries(), soil_country(), soil_dataset(), soil_datasets(), soil_formats(), soil_ttr_flag_legend(), soil_variable_mappings()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
v <- soil_variables(soil, dataset = "wise_profiles")
v[, c("variable_code", "name", "property_family")]
soil_variable_mappings(v)
} # }
